# Case 34: Title, index terms, and contribution items off pattern
Skill: write-abstracts-and-conclusions
Expected gates: G-AC-title, G-AC-kw, G-AC-contrib, G-STY-contrib
Language: en
Snippet:
> Title: Towards Novel and Efficient Robot Delivery. Index Terms: Optimization, Robots, Deep Learning, and Smart Campus. Contributions: (1) We are the first to study mobile stations. (2) We use NSGA-II. (3) Extensive experiments verify the superiority.
